Thunder Hole, Acadia NP, Maine, is a geological formation known for a thunder-like sound and water sprays. Formed by glacial activity, it's a 10 ft channel where waves create compressed air and water sprays. Best viewed 2 hours before high tide. Accessible via Park Loop Rd, with parking and trails. Handicapped spots and shuttle bus available.

item.title: Abdulla Avloni Memorial Museum in Tashkent, Uzbekistan
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: original reporting with useful context

The Abdulla Avloni Memorial Museum, founded in 1968, moved from Avloni's Tashkent house to an institute named after him. Avloni, a Muslim reformer, was a key figure in Central Asia's renewal. The museum showcases his desk, typewriter, and personal items, along with early 20th-century books and newspapers. A red display features AI-animated Avloni and fellow reformers. The museum is free and offers guided tours and a virtual tour. Located at 6 Ziyo Street, Olmazor District, Tashkent.

The Antigravity A1 drone, released in 2025, offers a dual-lens 360-degree capture system, eliminating blind spots and providing a 'fly now, frame later' experience.
